judged_text: The spec added for the controller that carries all the new persistence behavior (save_host with the blank-category→uncategorized fallback, validation failure → render_json_error, update/destroy) contains only one assertion — that the class is a subclass of AdminController — and the sibling embedding_controller_spec.rb is identical; no assertion anywhere in the diff covers create/update/destroy request handling. A regression in save_host (e.g. the category_id blank fallback, or the 500-on-missing-id behavior above) ships green; the only 'verification' for the feature's write path is a class-hierarchy check, which is why the nil-host crash in the controller is uncaught.
